messages:
alex: FYI - ACME (private deployment in eu-west-1) reporting intermittent 500s + high token latency since ~14:10 UTC. Customer provided a few request ids: r-20260315-9f3a, r-20260315-a2b7, r-20260315-c11d. Asking for a debug bundle from their private instance and guidance on what we need.

maria: Thanks — can you paste the exact request IDs + timestamps you saw? Also we should give them a curl repro and a collector script so they can generate without sharing creds.

alex: Pasted IDs above. Timestamps roughly 2026-03-15T14:11:02Z, 2026-03-15T14:22:10Z, 2026-03-15T14:28:49Z. Customer says they saw latency spikes up to ~3s per token.

sam: For Private deployments we have two recommended collectors depending on topology: the host-level collector (/opt/redwood/bin/collect-debug.sh) and the agent collector (private-collector) that runs inside the VPC. Ask customer to run host collector if they have shell access, otherwise use the agent wrapper.

sam: Host collector minimal command (give them exactly):
```
sudo /opt/redwood/bin/collect-debug.sh \
  --output /tmp/acme-debug.tar.gz \
  --since "2026-03-15T14:00:00Z" \
  --include-logs redwood-api redwood-runtime \
  --include-config \
  --include-metrics
```
It will bundle logs, jstack, docker/container info.

sam: If they only have the private-collector container, run:
```
docker run --rm -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock \
  -v /tmp:/out redwood/private-collector:stable \
  collect --since 2026-03-15T14:00:00Z --out /out/acme-debug.tar.gz
```

jenna: Security note — before upload they MUST redact secrets and PII. Provide them a redact.conf and recommend the following patterns to drop:
- API keys: `(?i)api_key\s*[:=]\s*\S+`
- Authorization headers: `Authorization:\s*Bearer\s*\S+`
- Private certs/keys under /etc/ssl or /home/*/.ssh
Also exclude `/home/*/.gnupg` and `/etc/secret` mounts.

jenna: Sample simple redact command (host):
```
/opt/redwood/bin/redact-bundle.sh /tmp/acme-debug.tar.gz --patterns /tmp/redact.conf --out /tmp/acme-debug-redacted.tar.gz
```
Provide the redact.conf with the request.

alex: Good. Also include repro curl to capture the exact headers we saw. Ask them to run from their network to reproduce token latency and include `x-request-id` header in response. Example: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1-small","input":"Hello world"}' \
  "https://private.acme.redwood.local/v1/generate" \
  -D - | sed -n '1,80p'
```
And if it returns 500 include the raw response and response headers (we need x-request-id). If they can reproduce with slow responses capture `tcpdump -w /tmp/net.pcap host <inference-host-ip> and port 443` for the period.

maria: Also ask them to collect a debug log of the agent's KV cache size and active batching snapshot:
```
# on runtime host
curl -s --unix-socket /var/run/redwood.sock http://localhost/debug/batching | jq . > /tmp/batching.json
curl -s --unix-socket /var/run/redwood.sock http://localhost/debug/kvcache | jq . > /tmp/kvcache.json
```
These endpoints exist on Private 1.8+.

tyler: For secure upload we prefer S3 presigned POSTs. I can generate a one-time presigned URL tied to ticket ACME-342. If customer cannot use that, provide SCP to a bastion we control. I'll create presigned link valid 24h.

tyler: (automated) presign-url created: https://s3.eu-west-1.redwood-internal/acme-debug/1749800123/acme-debug-redacted.tar.gz?X-EXAMPLE=... (will DM the link, do not post in channel).

support-bot: Ticket ACME-342 updated and linked to thread 1749800123. Priority: P2.

alex: I'll DM the customer with step-by-step and redact.conf template (jenna — can you drop redact.conf here or DM?). I'll ask them to run both collector + curl repro and upload via Tyler's presigned link.

jenna: Dropping minimal redact.conf (example to copy into /tmp/redact.conf):
```
# redact.conf
(?i)Authorization: Bearer \S+
(?i)api_key\s*[:=]\s*\S+
(?i)private_key\s*[:=]\s*\S+
ssh-rsa|ssh-ed25519|-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----
```

alex: ETA to customer: sending now. Will update when upload complete. Thanks all. :raised_hands:

maria: If they can't run collectors we can schedule a quick session and run with their ops via a temporary jumpbox.

alex: Noted — will escalate if needed. Closing the loop in this thread after upload.
